intro: Tech executives signed a voluntary AI safety accord this week as the industry faces mounting pressure for regulation, with California passing comprehensive worker protections and a Japanese court ruling that human voices warrant legal protection in AI cases. Autonomous AI agents are becoming accessible to mainstream users, while Google released its most powerful Gemini model—Gemini 4 Argon—to a restricted group of cybersecurity experts due to safety concerns. Chip infrastructure continues to expand, with Anthropic securing up to $42 billion in AI chip financing from Broadcom and SpaceX preparing to launch Google's AI processors into orbit for space-based data centers.
